items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: You mean Pablo, about Spain, getting out.

ctx.x: Take somebody like Casals, after all he just stood for what he stood for, but he was --
You mean Pablo, about Spain, getting out.
Yes. I mean he took his stand and so on, but music was his -- he was first and foremost the musician that he was.
